services.desc: CONGRATULATIONS!! You’re officially booked with Skydive St. Louis, and everyone here is already fired up to welcome you to the dropzone. Now, one quick thing before you arrive. Please read through the info on this page. It’s the stuff that keeps your jump day fun, smooth, and stress-free, so you can focus on the best parts: the anticipation, the adrenaline, and that post-landing “I can’t believe I just did that” grin. Please plan to budget up to 4 hours for your experience. Will it always take that long? Not usually. services.desc: If you’re ready for the adventure of a lifetime, tandem skydiving is the perfect way to make your first skydive! Skydive St. Louis specializes in tandem skydiving so you can rest assured that you’ll be getting the ultimate tandem skydiving experience when you jump with us! As a tandem skydiver, you will be securely attached to one of our highly experienced USPA certified instructors throughout the whole jump. Your tandem instructor will be responsible for your safety and security every step of the skydiving process.
